mathematics.assertion_tested: Positive tensor-column coefficient weights; K-independent low-degree Hardy contraction; exact Bernstein marginals and linear clock K/2 for a one-mode matrix inner function; a nonuniform negative control.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Q(i), rational symbolic functions and exact rational residues.
mathematics.conventions: Ordered tensor entries grouped by output-count k only after their phase coefficients are formed; all occupation amplitudes summed coherently before taking absolute squares.
inputs: Second external column of S4, two internal variables, total degree <=8, K=1..6.
Hadamard-mixed degree-one Blaschke matrix inner function, K=1..10; all one-variable degrees integrated exactly.
non_claims: No efficient algorithm for the exponentially many coefficients at large N.
No inference from these finite controls to all unitary inputs without the analytic proof.
